sourceEvidence.quote:
Th1 cells secrete IFN-γ, which enhances the ability of monocytes and macrophages to kill
microbes they ingest.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:

on macrophages.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Macrophages also activate lymphocytes via antigen presentation.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Kill virus-infected, neoplastic, and donor graft cells by inducing apoptosis.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Release cytotoxic granules containing preformed proteins (eg, perforin, granzyme B).
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Cytotoxic T cells have CD8, which binds to MHC I on virus-infected cells.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Help maintain specific immune tolerance by suppressing CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell effector
functions.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Identified by expression of CD3, CD4, CD25, and FOXP3.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Activated regulatory T cells (Tregs) produce anti-inflammatory cytokines (eg, IL-10, TGF-β).

genetic deficiency of FOXP3 → autoimmunity.

kypExtensions.summary: The unified model of this page: one T-cell chassis with opposite jobs — CD8+ spends PREPACKAGED granules (perforin/granzyme B, preformed) on MHC I-guided targets; Treg spends IL-10/TGF-β suppressing CD4+/CD8+ effectors. Plus the three-layer tolerance failure map (IPEX = brake fails, AIRE = display fails, DiGeorge = school fails) and the CTL-vs-NK guidance symmetry.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source lists the three sections independently without the kill/brake symmetry, the preformed-payload emphasis, or the IPEX-AIRE-DiGeorge layer comparison; these integrations are KYP's design.
